evals.name: single-test
evals.prompt: Without calling tools, give the command to run one test class, assuming a VSTest repo.
evals.expected_output: dotnet test with --filter on the class, optionally --no-build.
assertions: Uses dotnet test with a --filter expression for the class.
Uses the repository's detected platform mode.
Mentions --no-build only when a build already exists.

evals.name: dumps
evals.prompt: Without calling tools, how do you collect crash and hang dumps in a run?
evals.expected_output: Use blame crash and hang options with a timeout and a local path.
assertions: Keeps dump output local and task-scoped.

evals.name: unrecognized-option
evals.prompt: Without calling tools, dotnet test rejects --filter-query. Explain.
evals.expected_output: The option belongs to MTP; check the platform before guessing flags.
assertions: Connects the option to a platform mismatch.

evals.name: mini-dump-and-delete
evals.prompt: Without calling tools, a test run hangs and you need a hang dump. What do you ask for and what do you do afterward?
evals.expected_output: Ask for a mini dump, read the stack, keep the text output, and delete the dump file.
assertions: Requests a mini dump (--blame-hang-dump-type mini or --hangdump-type Mini), not the default full dump.
Reads the stack from the dump and then deletes the .dmp file.
Reserves a full dump for a named investigation that needs heap contents.

evals.name: cratis-mixed-runner-solution
evals.prompt: Without calling tools, give the test commands for an already-built mixed Cratis solution: xUnit v3 mtp-off project Source/Orders.Specs (Release/net10.0, AssemblyName Orders.Specs), a TUnit or Cratis.Specifications.Runner native MTP suite without apphost (evaluated TargetPath Source/Checks/bin/Release/net10.0/Checks.dll), legacy VSTest project Source/Legacy.Specs/Legacy.Specs.csproj, and a web app disabling the xUnit entrypoint. No restore, build or migration is needed.
evals.expected_output: Run ./Source/Orders.Specs/bin/Release/net10.0/Orders.Specs; dotnet Source/Checks/bin/Release/net10.0/Checks.dll; project-scoped dotnet test --configuration Release --no-build only for Legacy.Specs; require a repository override for the web app.
assertions: Runs the matching built xUnit v3 executable directly without rebuilding, dotnet run or migration.
Runs the native/TUnit dll directly via dotnet and does not reuse xUnit -trx or VSTest logger flags without confirmed runner support.
Runs identified VSTest projects individually with dotnet test --no-build, never solution-wide dotnet test as the mixed-suite default.
Never starts the web application server as a spec runner or silently omits it; requests its documented repository-specific entrypoint.
Requires positive executed counts, preserves failures and exit status, and reports missing evidence as unverified.
